inline.headline: The laundry jobs nobody remembers.
inline.text: Add the yearly dryer clean as a repeating job, with who's helping you shift it, and it comes up on your list when it's due.
inline.alt: A dad and his teenage son lifting a clothes dryer away from the laundry wall, a vacuum beside them

jobs.title: Vacuum behind the clothes dryer
jobs.description: Needs two people. Unplug it, shift it, vacuum the lint.
directions: Turn it off at the wall and unplug it
Shift it out with a second person
Vacuum behind, under and around it
Check the cord, then push it back with room around it

end.headline: Warm towels. Nothing to worry about.
end.alt: A child laughing as a parent wraps them in a warm towel from a laundry basket

jobs.title: Get the dryer's burning smell checked
jobs.description: Smells hot on long cycles. Stopped using it until it's looked at.
directions: Turn it off at the wall
Note the model number on the door
Ask about the filters and thermostat
